{"data":[{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.936000","updated_at":null,"id":"e0c3lw2x5m9vjdrk3oqngjj3","character_name":"Courier","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Courier answered the Magical Letterbox in person. He expressed frustration to the party about not having delivered their earlier letters or the loose acorns they had entrusted to him. He produced a handful of loose acorns and the undelivered letter, snatched Bronn Boromir’s new letter, and trudged off down the mountain while carrying all three undelivered parcels and waving his middle fingers.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.821000","updated_at":null,"id":"pahpa4gpeuxnvx9n6ozv5vt3","character_name":"Bogo Boromir","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Bogo Boromir is Bronn Boromir’s uncle. Bronn addressed him as “Uncle BOGO” when composing a message. Bronn used the mountain’s Magical Letterbox to send Bogo a letter stating he had taken down a dragon and demanding pride in the deed.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.707000","updated_at":null,"id":"jyo4bb55tat0qva20e4017pf","character_name":"Sybil","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Merchant Sybil","Sybil's Storefront"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Sybil is the owner of a charred storefront in Byriver. When Bronn Boromir banged on her shuttered door, she answered with a grumbly voice, telling him to "get the fuck out of here" and accusing him of being a looter. She refused to open the door or assist. Later, she approached the Keep with Philip, Tower Guards, and Fireworks Troupe, shouting the party's names and joining those who hailed them as heroes.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.478000","updated_at":null,"id":"bpma6otgrarkbbwcgjxpy727","character_name":"Pepe","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Pepe is a small companion dragon conjured by Dookeldorn Bludvart.
Dookeldorn summoned Pepe after recognizing his brother's teaspoon in Haldraxis's tea bowl. During a fight with a mountain giant, Pepe contributed to Dookeldorn's attacks, lunging and tearing a chunk of flesh from one giant and later ripping into another giant's backside. On the Keep roof, Pepe added damage to strikes against Haldraxis, was hit by the dragon's fire, and retrieved a distinctive, soaked handkerchief belonging to Dookeldorn's brother from Haldraxis's corpse.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:52:11.886000","updated_at":null,"id":"gddciuzgr9co4vry5zpflas3","character_name":"Clive","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Clive is a Mountain Giants located inside the dragon’s lair. When someone called out his name, a voice from the Steam-Filled Chamber responded. Clive said, “not that” and then, “no. Not your hip again. The healer just did things to that to fix it.” Two Mountain Giants emerged from the steam in response to the call.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:46.128000","updated_at":null,"id":"f99ub9i28mbd1fb1m5zblzpf","character_name":"Haldraxis","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Haldraxis, also known as Hal'Draxas, is a young red dragon the size of a house, known for breathing fire and considered a major threat. Mountain Giants have written fondly about Haldraxis, indicating a bond or dealings with him. Haldraxis attacked and devastated Byriver, extorting gold from the town. He demanded that By River deliver ten thousand gold to Old Temple Ruins and stated he would return daily to wait for the payment. Haldraxis warned that if the payment was not produced by the end of four days, he would destroy the countryside.
During a confrontation, Haldraxis landed on crumbling structures with enormous leathery wings and claws, inspecting the ruins while demanding overdue gold from Gideon Xander and threatening the town. He dodged a collapsing arch but was struck in the gizzard and throat. In a moment of aggression, he lunged at Dookeldorn Bludvart, knocking him prone, and attempted to breathe fire but choked due to his injuries. Wounded, Haldraxis launched into the air and fled over the mountain peaks into the fog, declaring that By River would pay. His flight path led to a nearby lair, where he later lay asleep near a Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold) of approximately five thousand gold pieces, still bearing the earlier wound, snoring puffs of smoke and sipping from a cold, Dragon-Sized Bowl Of Chamomile Tea. Haldraxis also casts an illusion over his dung to alter its appearance.
While asleep, Hal'Draxas was attacked and awakened when his throat was struck again. He roared that the city would burn and fled through the Mountainside Opening toward By River. He later perched on the highest point of the Keep, sighted the approaching party, reared, and began building fire in his throat to incinerate them. He was driven back by covering ballista fire, slammed the roof while pacing, dropped lower, and blasted Bronn, Gideon, and Pepe with dragonfire. He was then struck by a necrotic touch that burst his old wounds, crashing dead onto the roof with a final roar and exhaling smoke as his body went limp.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:46.008000","updated_at":null,"id":"f3e4cxtcwsvi4dm0y56zc3rw","character_name":"Drogba","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Drogba is identified as a barbarian and is confirmed to be dead. Dookeldorn Bludvart stated during a campfire conversation on the first night that he knew Drogba was dead.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.889000","updated_at":null,"id":"fhmwm3fvabxo8eutv9nfzirk","character_name":"Gil","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Gil is a postal carrier dressed in navy-blue robes with a name tag that reads "Gil." He has a worn, unkempt facial appearance. At sunrise, he is magically summoned from a mountain mailbox after a silver is dropped in. He appears startled, puts out his hand, takes Gideon Xander's letter, and begins trudging down the mountain. Gideon hands him an additional sealed envelope that he is instructed not to open; Gil accepts it while expressing that he would have slapped the letter away. Bronn Boromir offers him tea, but he refuses, citing union constraints, and leaves immediately. Later, Gil reappears covered in icicles, carrying two undelivered letters. He accepts a pile of acorns handed to him and gathers them into his pockets one by one before trudging back down the mountain.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.768000","updated_at":null,"id":"vddisocq4o19batalajy9ghx","character_name":"Macy","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Macy is a member of the Arcano Academy's group of healing-school students. She frequents the Beachside Mirage bar with Tracy, Lacey, and Stacy. During a recent visit to the bar, she was not at the corner booth; instead, she was searching for an older or more mature gentleman, a detail noted by others when asked about her whereabouts.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.649000","updated_at":null,"id":"mhsosnh3c6vrqhaq0sgzuqrp","character_name":"Philip","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Philip is a human man dressed in a ceremonial guard outfit, consuming fire whiskey and displaying signs of distress. Philip informed E.t. Skittles that a dragon had attacked Byriver and that he was at the resort to recruit wizards, offering a reward of three hundred gold for anyone involved in the dragon's capture or death. He indicated a brooding man in the corner booth as a likely adventurer and encouraged E.t. to recruit that group. Philip approached the booth with E.t. to recruit the group to confront the dragon and visibly relaxed once enough members agreed. He identified the dragon as Haldraxis, a young but dangerous red dragon that breathes fire. He explained that the dragon would return daily to Old Temple Ruins to collect the city's gold, provided each member with a map to the ruins, and noted that the Mountain Route would take two days while the Forest Route would take three. He also distributed healing potions and informed the party that the dragon demanded the city's gold within four days. The party followed Philip's map meticulously to reach the ancient mountain temple ruins where they awaited Haldraxis.
As the kingdom's delegate, Philip wore plumy Swiss-guard garb and remained unarmed, giving direction to the town's Tower Guards and staying at his post by order of the king. At the City Gate, he recognized the party's voices, called them heroes, and ordered the Gate raised. He stated he must remain to defend the Gate due to the expectation of more Mountain Giants and would not rouse the Fireworks Troupe himself. After Haldraxis was killed, he came to the Keep, greeted the party, and thanked them for saving the town. He doubled the promised reward to six hundred gold each and offered free rooms and drinks at the Flaming Wizard Tavern, along with store discounts.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.527000","updated_at":null,"id":"tpzth25uqthvo04p915x205a","character_name":"Luna Starshimmer","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Luna"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Luna Starshimmer is an elf bartender with waist-length midnight-blue hair, eyes that glimmer like starlight, and slightly luminescent skin. She is tall and graceful, wearing scantily clad clothing to attract spring-break tips. At the bar, she approached E.t. Skittles, took his order for mead, prepared it, anticipated the order, set out two meads on the house for E.t. and Philip, and handed the two meads to E.t.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.287000","updated_at":null,"id":"ehqj5hgueux4r6y4yq9mza9b","character_name":"Brax Thunderbrew","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Brax Thunderbrew is the owner of a tavern. He has a ruddy complexion and bright green eyes, and he wears simple, sturdy clothing suitable for combat and brewing ales.
One evening, he approached Gideon Xander and stated he was done arguing about Gideon's behavior. He ordered Gideon to break up an escalating scene in the corner and to take the large fellow with him. As Gideon left, Brax crumpled the pamphlet Gideon offered and tossed it onto a growing pile of Gideon's discarded pamphlets behind the bar. He noted that the ACs often turned the bar into an inappropriate scene but always had an open tab and spare drinks.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.928000","updated_at":null,"id":"p4navjstuw659zhg1svzii7n","character_name":"Stacy","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Stacy is one of three Arcano Academy students from the healing school, alongside Tracy and Lacey. She carried a crystal that she rubbed on a patron's back. Stacy slid into a crowded booth with Tracy and Lacey and asked Dookeldorn Bludvart whether he had been hurt. She directed a calming, comforting healing aura with the other two until Dookeldorn relaxed. Stacy coaxed Dookeldorn to talk about himself and asked probing questions about his scars and wounds. She participated in a shared toast and drinks with the others. When Gideon Xander approached, Stacy protested that they were only trying to heal Dookeldorn. After accepting one final offered round, she rose with Tracy and Lacey and left the booth. Stacy rubbed a crystal on Dookeldorn's back while hugging him and later remarked that the final drinks were "wildly disappointing."","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.804000","updated_at":null,"id":"dffy0ar3t99ao1glrvm9bww6","character_name":"Lacey","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Lacey is a student at the Arcano Academy's healing school. She is one of three students who identified themselves as "Tracy, Lacey, and Stacy." Lacey slid into a corner booth with Tracy and Stacy and participated in a calming, comforting healing aura directed at Dookeldorn Bludvart. She signaled a server, who brought a tray of shots and a bottle. Lacey joined in a toast and drink with her companions. Later, Gideon Xander persuaded the three to take one last round and relocate. Lacey accepted the offered shot but left the booth with Tracy and Stacy when they discovered the drink was water, departing the corner disappointed.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.678000","updated_at":null,"id":"pg6ai18z0ziw7q7ia0rthfsy","character_name":"Tracy","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Tracy is a student of the academy's healing school. She carries a satchel containing crystals and healing components and, along with Lacey and Stacy, emanates a strong calming healing aura.
Tracy slid into Dookeldorn Bludvart's booth with Lacey and Stacy, pulled out crystals, and hovered one over his injuries to demonstrate healing. The trio directed a pervasive calming aura until Dookeldorn relaxed and began responding. Tracy remained present while the group conversed until Gideon Xander offered one last round; she took a shot with the others and left the booth after that final drink.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false}],"total":15,"page":1,"size":20,"pages":1}
